# Zaa's Food (zaaasfood) — 3D Portfolio | Izanagi Faris Aslam

> Interactive 3D Ramen Store Portfolio of **Izanagi Faris Aslam**, Software Engineering & Full Stack Developer from Indonesia.

- **URL:** https://zaaasfood.izanagifaris.my.id/
- **Main Portfolio:** https://www.izanagifaris.my.id/
- **Tech Stack:** Three.js, WebGL, GLSL Shaders, GSAP, Blender, Vite
- **Author:** Izanagi Faris Aslam (`Izanagi05`)

## Interactive Areas
- **Refrigerator (Kulkas):** Project showcase (`RPLU 18`, `TicTacToe`, `Spline 3D`, `Gunting Kertas Batu`, `MyIntGame`)
- **TV Monitor:** About Me, Interests, Tech Stack, and social links
- **Arcade Cabinet:** Credits and retro audio mode
- **Rooftop Ramen Hologram:** Custom Three.js `Points` particle hologram
